verdict.rationale: Motion documents custom availability through a drag-and-drop interface and lets users set ideal meeting windows (e.g., focused mornings, meeting-free Fridays). Custom time windows for tasks also cover recurring working-hours schedules. Nothing in the evidence shows date-specific overrides or out-of-office periods, so only about a third of the story is evidenced. Missing for 10: date overrides, out-of-office periods, in-depth docs on availability schedule configuration, independent/hands-on corroboration.
